method: Five pinned files whole text read; Git blob identity independently verified. Static source review only.
findings: apps.rs discovers shell AppsFolder entries through fixed PowerShell script, checks exit status and parses JSON, then deduplicates launch targets using ASCII lowercase. This is app identity by launch target, not file-content duplicate detection. Non-ASCII equivalent paths and aliases remain unqualified.
Installed app metadata errors/default unavailable dates become zero; is_file_system remains separate but no metadata-error field. Missing reveal path does not remove entry.

Icon cache is process-global HashMap keyed by ASCII-lowercased shell parsing name; no eviction, bound, timestamp/version invalidation or negative cache in reviewed module. Static retention/staleness risk only, no memory or latency benchmark.

Icon conversion requests64x64 with BIGGERSIZEOK; allocates width*height*4 from returned bitmap without explicit maximum/checked multiply; GetDIBits checks only nonzero, not full requested scanline count. Source robustness observations, not demonstrated real shell failure.

COM initialization guard correctly balances successful initialization and avoids uninitializing RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE branch. Bitmap/DC normal and explicit error branches release handles; no real COM/GDI execution.
PowerShell discovery .output has no timeout/cancellation in reviewed helper. Icon command calls synchronous shell rendering; actual Tauri scheduling and UI latency unmeasured.
main.rs only launches library. Tauri config/Cargo version0.1.16 but Win32 assembly version0.2.0.0; packaging consistency observation, not proven installer failure.
Manifest explicitly requestsAdministrator as README states. Asset scope includes C through Z plus standard folders, not explicit A/B or UNC roots. Rendering behavior there unqualified.

Capability refers main window; updater config specifies public verification key and release endpoint. Public key is repository configuration, not user secret. No update endpoint requested or release executed.
limits: 19/268 pinned files reviewed. Whole repository/runtime remain incomplete.
No Powershell, application launch, shell/registry action, installer, updater, Windows COM/GDI, Tauri runtime or production dependency change.
No new implementation test justified for static research-only changes; previous source controls remain separate evidence. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
